text: All seven Phase 6 children are closed. mvpa-fit, mvpa-dataset, and mvpa-spatial are removed from disk/build; their retained evidence, kernels, dataset construction, and spatial frames live directly in one mvpa module. The old public ontology, compatibility surfaces, and duplicate result shells are absent; current docs and examples use only the unified vocabulary; the zero-cruft court and strict JVM/Scala.js gate pass.
